title: Date windows that decide what a project allows
question: Are these date windows intended? Setup opens 30 days before the start date, construction runs to start plus duration, and the project is archived for 365 days after that. Should a Track3D-created first project be set up immediately whatever its start date?
context: Code derives access stage from dates (PROJ-REQ-014). As a result, a deal-led first project starting more than 30 days out can't be set up yet, which conflicts with the confirmed immediate-setup rule (PROJ-REQ-002, PROJ-REQ-003).
options: Open setup immediately for approved projects
Make the windows configurable per project
